metadata.description: Lightweight probes for the real AstrBot memory footprint (Pss + SwapPss), plugin import cost and retained reference graph, without tracemalloc.

memory.auth.title: Connect to the observer
memory.auth.desc: Use the token from the observer configuration. It stays in this page memory only.
memory.数据已过期，下面保留上次成功结果。: Data is stale. The last successful result is shown below.
memory.本地模式：尚未连接独立后端，仅显示 AstrBot 进程和本地诊断。: Local mode: no observer connected. Showing the AstrBot process and local diagnostics only.
memory.部分数据读取失败: Some data could not be loaded
memory.从服务总量到插件证据，先看变化，再找原因。: Watch the service, explore the changes, follow the evidence.
memory.清单、启动增量和诊断证据，放在同一张表里。: Inventory, startup deltas and diagnostic evidence in one place.
memory.还原加载顺序，区分导入、构造与初始化。: Trace loading order across import, construction and initialization.
memory.需要时再深入，日常查看不会自动扫描对象。: Go deeper on demand. Viewing the dashboard never starts a scan.
memory.对比停用前后，验证实际能省下多少内存。: Compare repeated runs to measure the effect of excluding a plugin.
memory.理解数字的边界，才不会把线索当结论。: Understand what each number can, and cannot, tell you.
memory.请检查插件后端配置和服务状态，然后点击刷新。: Check the observer settings and service, then refresh.
memory.真实采样点 · 悬停查看 · 拖动放大: Real samples · Hover to inspect · Drag to zoom
memory.按加载期间 RSS + Swap 增量排序: Ranked by RSS + Swap delta during loading
memory.进程包含在服务总量中，不要重复相加: Included in the service total; do not add twice
memory.包括换出量，并非物理内存: Includes swapped pages; not physical usage
memory.持续观察，不打扰日常使用。: Continuous observation with light background sampling.
memory.启动增量是线索，不是插件当前独占内存。: Startup deltas are clues, not current exclusive plugin memory.
memory.长时间范围保留峰谷显示；统计基于显示点。: Long ranges retain peaks and troughs. Statistics use displayed points.
memory.自动适应纵轴，避免启动尖峰压平日常波动。: Adaptive scaling keeps everyday changes readable.
memory.后端将在下一次采样时更新。: The observer will update these at the next sample.
memory.试试清空搜索或切换筛选条件。: Clear the search or change the filter.
memory.插件清单通常每分钟同步；未接入启动探针时，启动增量会保持未知。: Inventory normally syncs every minute. Without an early probe, startup deltas remain unknown.
memory.— 表示未测到；* 表示只包含部分阶段。增量不能当作当前占用。: — means unknown; * means partial phases. Deltas are not current usage.
memory.本地导入统计只覆盖本插件加载之后；完整启动记录需要早期探针。: Local import tracking starts after this plugin loads. Full startup records require the early probe.
memory.从进程出现到服务就绪: From process creation to service readiness
memory.共享依赖不重复分摊: Shared dependencies are not counted twice
memory.探针记录完整。时间段增量仍可能混入并发工作。: Probe records are complete. Concurrent work can still affect interval deltas.
memory.探针记录不完整或未启用；没有测到的值保持未知。: Probe incomplete or disabled. Missing measurements remain unknown.
memory.按实际发生顺序排列；点击插件查看完整证据。: In loading order. Select a plugin to inspect its evidence.
memory.窗口增量不是独占内存，负值表示该时段总量下降。: Interval deltas are not exclusive usage. Negative values mean the total decreased.
memory.首次导入者不等于唯一使用者；不为共享包虚构占用大小。: The first importer is not the sole user. No size is invented for shared packages.
memory.未启用早期探针的批次，可能只有粗略日志窗口或没有记录。: Runs without an early probe may have only rough log windows or no records.
memory.读取插件源码，找出可能在加载时引入的重依赖。不会扫描对象堆。: Read plugin sources to find heavy imports at module load time. No heap scan.
memory.估算 Python 对象的归属。可能引起短暂停顿和换入，不覆盖所有原生库内存。: Estimate Python object ownership. May pause the process or swap pages in. Native memory is not fully covered.
memory.沿插件引用查找持有对象，区分独有与共享引用。会消耗 CPU，建议空闲时使用。: Follow plugin references to retained objects and distinguish exclusive and shared references. Uses CPU; run when idle.
memory.独立页面无法访问进程内对象。请在 AstrBot 的 MemoryScope 插: The standalone page cannot access in-process objects. Run diagnostics from the MemoryScope page in AstrBot.
memory.独立页面显示后端保存的最近诊断；要立即执行扫描，请在 AstrBot 插件页操作: The standalone page shows the latest saved diagnostics. Run a scan from the AstrBot plugin page for an immediate update.
memory.这里的对象估算不能与启动增量或 RSS 相加。: Object estimates cannot be added to startup deltas or RSS.
memory.连接后端时不持续运行本地扫描，这不是服务器告警流。: Local scans are not continuous in observer mode. This is not a server alert feed.
memory.GC 不保证降低 RSS；仅在排查问题时按需使用。: GC does not guarantee lower RSS. Use only when troubleshooting.
memory.导出报告可以保存当前证据，文件不包含连接凭据。: Export the current evidence. The file contains no connection credentials.
memory.选择上方工具运行一次。未测量不代表插件占用为零。: Choose a tool above. Unmeasured does not mean zero usage.
memory.依赖审计只读取源码，可能短时使用 CPU。: The audit reads source files and may briefly use CPU.
memory.对象普查可能暂停消息处理并引起内存换入。它不会得到精确的逐插件 RSS。: A census may pause message processing and swap pages in. It cannot produce exact per-plugin RSS.
memory.引用图扫描会分片处理对象，但仍会消耗 CPU 并触碰内存。建议在空闲时执行。: The reference scan runs in slices but still uses CPU and touches memory. Run when idle.
memory.垃圾回收可能引起短暂停顿，并不保证内存数字下降。: Garbage collection may briefly pause processing. Usage may not decrease.
memory.A 正常启动 → B 临时排除 → A 恢复验证: A normal → B temporarily excluded → A restored
memory.会真实重启 AstrBot，机器人会暂时离线。仅影响实验启动，不删除业务数据。: This restarts AstrBot and takes the bot offline temporarily. Only experiment launches change; business data is preserved.
memory.后端未开放重启实验，日常观察不需要开启。: Restart experiments are disabled on the observer. Everyday observation does not need them.
memory.我理解实验会多次重启 AstrBot，并已选择合适的时间。: I understand this will restart AstrBot multiple times and have chosen a suitable time.
memory.单轮仅是初步线索；多轮仍需尽量保持消息量和工作负载一致。: A single round is preliminary. Keep traffic and workload comparable across repeated rounds.
memory.任务由后端执行，关闭页面不会终止。: The observer runs the job. Closing this page does not stop it.
memory.日常查看无需创建实验。: Everyday observation does not require an experiment.
memory.次重启。期间机器人会离线，结束后恢复正常启动。: restarts. The bot will go offline during the experiment and return to its normal configuration afterward.
memory.实验已交给后端执行: The observer is running the experiment
memory.服务物理记账包括 AstrBot、其子进程和文件缓存。匿名内存 + Swap 包: Service physical usage includes AstrBot, child processes and file cache. Anonymous + Swap includes swapped-out pages; it is not physical usage.
memory.PSS 分摊进程间的共享页，不能再拆成每个 Python 插件的独占账单。: PSS apportions shared pages between processes. It cannot provide an exclusive bill for each Python plugin.
memory.探针记录导入、构造、初始化的时间窗口。窗口内还有其他后台任务，共享库也可能被多个: The probe records import, construction and initialization windows. Other tasks can run concurrently, and libraries can be shared by several plugins.
memory.负增量表示该时间段总量下降。— 表示未采集或无法分辨，不能当作零。: A negative delta means the total fell in that interval. — means unmeasured or unresolved, never zero.
memory.普查主要看可追踪的 Python 对象；引用图扫描看插件仍持有的对象。原生库、共: The census covers tracked Python objects; a reference scan covers retained objects. Native libraries, shared references and scan budgets limit coverage.
memory.不开扫描也能查看后端趋势、插件清单与启动记录。日常无需开启自动普查。: Observer trends, inventory and startup records work without scans. Everyday use does not need automatic census.
memory.重复进行正常启动、临时排除、恢复验证，观察稳定窗口的差值与波动。机器人会在实验期: Repeat normal, excluded and restored launches, then compare stable-window differences and variation. The bot goes offline several times.
memory.结果只适用于当时的插件组合和工作负载。多个插件的节省量不能直接相加。: Results apply to that plugin combination and workload. Savings for different plugins cannot simply be added.
memory.日常选择 15 分钟或 1 小时；排查启动再选择本次启动。纵轴默认自适应，可切换: Use 15 minutes or 1 hour for daily observation and This run for startup. The vertical axis adapts by default; zero-based scaling is optional.
memory.悬停或点击查看时间与数值；电脑拖动放大区间，点击复位还原。方向键逐点查看，Esc: Hover or tap for a timestamp and value. Drag on desktop to zoom and Reset to restore. Arrow keys inspect points; Escape resets. Missing points never become zero.
memory.独立后端持续保存采样，插件只负责安全转发与展示。后端离线时显示错误或过期记录，不: The observer continuously stores samples. The plugin securely forwards and displays them. Failures show errors or stale records, not fake zero usage.
memory.仅本地模式无法回溯早于本插件的导入。进程内诊断需在 AstrBot 插件页执行，: Local mode cannot measure imports before this plugin loaded. Run in-process diagnostics inside AstrBot; use the standalone page for observation and comparisons.
memory.这个批次没有该插件的详情: No details for this plugin in the selected run
memory.RSS + Swap；非当前独占占用: RSS + Swap; not current exclusive usage
memory.该插件记录到的阶段合计: Sum of recorded phases for this plugin
memory.窗口增量可能含并发工作。共享依赖首次出现在这里，不代表只被这个插件使用。: Interval deltas may include concurrent work. Dependencies first appearing here may also be used by other plugins.
memory.插件清单仍可见；需要早期探针才能记录完整导入。: The plugin inventory is still visible. Full import records require the early probe.
memory.停止后续实验并恢复正常启动；可能需要再重启一次 AstrBot。: Stop subsequent rounds and restore normal startup. AstrBot may need one more restart.
memory.未找到 AstrBot 页面桥接，请从插件页面重新打开。: AstrBot page bridge is missing. Reopen this page from the plugin dashboard.
memory.缩短或扩大时间范围，或等待下一次采样。: Change the time range or wait for the next sample.
memory.内存趋势，左右方向键查看采样点，拖动放大，Escape 复位。: Memory trend. Arrow keys inspect points, drag to zoom, Escape resets.
memory.检测到差异，请结合波动与环境判断: Difference observed; assess variability and environment
memory.title: Memory Observatory
memory.theme.hint: Applies instantly. Your choice is saved.
